name: Event countdown
description: A launch-screen countdown for a conference, opening or product launch: the event name, a tagline and the date and venue, a big live countdown that switches to your own message when the moment arrives, and an optional ticket or RSVP QR code.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: tagline
params.label: Tagline
params.default: Two days of talks, builds and late-night demos from the people shipping what comes next.

params.name: target
params.label: Count down to
params.help: ISO 8601 with a timezone offset, e.g. 2027-03-18T09:00:00+00:00 or 2027-03-18T09:00:00-05:00. Without an offset the server's own timezone is used.

params.name: show_qr
params.label: Show the ticket QR code
params.help: Turn off if you have no link — the QR, its card and caption all disappear.

params.name: qr_url
params.label: Ticket / RSVP link
params.help: The address the QR code opens. Keep it short: shorter links make a code that scans from further away.

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: A square-ish PNG or SVG with a transparent background. Shown top left.

params.name: background_image
params.label: Background photo
params.help: Optional. A hero or venue photo behind everything; it is darkened by the setting below.

params.name: background_dim
params.label: Darken the photo
params.help: 0 = the photo as is, 0.9 = almost black. Only used with a background photo.
